source: Experiments use the iteration-budget fix and benchmark delivered alongside this file.
notes: Every run is a two-second moving-bowl rollout with 6645 particles, two substeps/frame, fixed material parameters, and no rendering.
Timings exclude compilation and the first ten frames; include sparse rebuild status, swept projection, and captured diagnostic copies.
Position errors are endpoint particle-identity comparisons with a discretized 100-sweep reference, not physical ground truth.
Packing excess is a last-substep grid quadrature diagnostic, not a lost-mass or physical-volume measurement.
Keep original report fields unchanged. Some earlier reports predate same-basis errors or kinetic-energy output.
Earlier point-bound prototypes and public pic512 have identical recorded quality metrics. Earlier report collider_basis=pic plus point_capacity=512 denotes the prototype, not unbounded sampling.
Concurrent GPU jobs substantially affect timing. Compare paired cases within a run; no isolated GPU throughput advantage is established.
The CR/GS containment failure is retained. Final containment alone cannot distinguish a wall crossing from escape through the open rim.

cell_capacity_comparison.result: All recorded rollout quality metrics matched; all sparse status checks passed.

runs.name: s2_serial
runs.command: uv run --extra dev asv/benchmarks/simulation/bench_mpm_low_iterations.py --frames 120 --cases gs2 gs5 gs10 gs20 cold2 jacobi_gs2 cr_gs2 xpbd_gs2 packing_gs2 packing_gs20 --output /tmp/mpm-low-iterations-4090-final.json
runs.load_note: Lower GPU load at start; serial cases are not an isolated timing experiment.

runs.name: unbounded_point_serial
runs.command: uv run --extra dev asv/benchmarks/simulation/bench_mpm_low_iterations.py --frames 120 --cases gs0 pic2 pic20 --output /tmp/mpm-low-iterations-4090-pic-final.json
runs.load_note: Concurrent GPU workload; outer capture disabled for unbounded point bases.

runs.name: bounded_point_paired_initial
runs.command: uv run --extra dev asv/benchmarks/simulation/bench_mpm_low_iterations.py --paired --frames 120 --cases gs2 gs5 gs20 pic_captured2 pic_captured20 --output /tmp/mpm-low-iterations-4090-paired.json
runs.point_bound_implementation: initial prototype: fixed quadrature cache, 512 points/cell
runs.load_note: Concurrent GPU workload. This initial prototype was subsequently replaced with public pic512 configuration.

runs.name: capacity_1024_paired
runs.command: uv run --extra dev asv/benchmarks/simulation/bench_mpm_low_iterations.py --paired --frames 120 --cases gs2 gs5 gs20 pic_captured2 pic_captured20 --cell-capacity 1024 --output /tmp/mpm-low-iterations-4090-capacity1024.json
runs.point_bound_implementation: initial prototype: fixed quadrature cache, 512 points/cell
runs.load_note: Concurrent GPU workload changed across voxel-size intervals. Do not attribute cross-run timing differences to capacity.

runs.name: public_pic512_paired
runs.command: uv run --extra dev asv/benchmarks/simulation/bench_mpm_low_iterations.py --paired --frames 120 --cases gs2 gs5 gs20 pic_captured2 pic_captured20 --output /tmp/mpm-low-iterations-4090-public-pic512.json
runs.load_note: Concurrent GPU workload. Confirms the final public-bound implementation with unchanged recorded quality metrics.
